title: Classify fixed nonlinear role recodings under exact ADD compatibility (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written obstruction with exact finite corroboration. Independent fixed zero-preserving scalar-role bijections conjugating a connected graph of unit ADDs into fixed scalar ADDs have exactly this form:

```text
f_v = s_v H,      H additive,      b_(source,target) = s_target/s_source
one unchanged i-phase compatibility => H is Q(i)-linear
pointwise Gaussian-native word: Phi A Phi^-1 = D A D^-1
```

Every such nonlinear recoding has a scalar-gauge counterpart with the same native operators, ADD coefficients, chronology and arbitrary-input endpoint. Its native paid profile is identical. No continuity, measurability or differentiability is assumed. This closes a precise nonlinear recoding escape route; it supplies no new kappa.

The proof and checker were produced by Nick Petalas. Cinna Davis's merged #4983 supplies the shared-potential predecessor, cited without replaying its source audit. Cauchy's functional equation, scalar gauge consistency and linear commutation are classical; the contribution is their complete independent-role classification and Gaussian-native application. Only six files in `research/nonlinear-role-recoding/` are added. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19228562).

## Evidence

Before, the shared-map criterion leaves independent role maps and changed edge coefficients unspecified. After, spanning-tree weights and cycle consistency classify them completely, and one phase compatibility propagates the coefficient-field constraint across the graph.

Local CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only:

- All 5,632 map/label assignments on 54 connected directed three-role graphs over F3, and 1,105,920 assignments on a path and triangle over F5. Literal gate equations agree with the classification; 432 and 128 assignments respectively are compatible.
- All 40,320 zero-preserving F9 permutations: 48 additive, 32 phase-compatible, eight both. Explicit witnesses delimit the two conditions.
- 48 complete seven-event fixtures over Q(i,sqrt(2)), including every rational basis column and mixed dirty inputs. Non-scalar Q(i)-linear recoding, direct scalar gauges and recoded instruction execution agree on 288 scalar outputs, comprising 1,152 rational components. An independent monomial product checks 81 extension-arithmetic pairs. Nine graph/domain/hypothesis controls pass.
- Normal and optimized warning-strict direct checks pass in 0.457 and 0.476 seconds. Both registered commands pass; their 60-second limits leave ample replay margin. These are replay-budget measurements, not a speedup claim.
- Metadata/source pins, staged whitespace, committed bytes/modes and source-history preflight pass. The official committed archive passes input coverage. Read-only, Git-free normal and optimized exported replays preserve all seven exported files and their modes. Generated stdout receipts bind all package hashes.

Reproduce from the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/nonlinear-role-recoding/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/nonlinear-role-recoding/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/nonlinear-role-recoding
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/nonlinear-role-recoding --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Another CPython 3.12 interpreter may replace the absolute path. Expected markers are `PASS_NONLINEAR_ROLE_RECODING`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The universal result rests on `PROOF.md`, not on finite-field testing.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The maps are fixed per role, pointwise, scalar and zero-preserving. ADD compatibility holds on all independent inputs; the graph is weakly connected and one role preserves multiplication by i. General nonlinear circuits, occurrence-dependent recodings, non-pointwise address maps, approximate/rounded identities and restricted reachable states are outside the claim.

This is equality of attainable native profiles within the declared recoding class. Physical encodings, boundary adapters, ordinary scalar costs, precision, storage, movement, a complete signed invoice and supplier/compiler/hosting admission remain separate. No selected-word scientific replay, Lean, Docker, complete multiplication theorem or selected-frontier update was performed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can occurrence-dependent recodings lower a complete helper invoice? Specify one changed pair of consecutive recodings and all replacement gates and boundary adapters, then price restoration, storage and the full signed bill. No such physical construction or budget is supplied here.

## Related open work

- #6015 studies data-dependent selection from a finite menu of fixed linear endpoint maps. This contribution instead classifies one fixed family of arbitrary role bijections through exact gate conjugacies; neither supplies the other's premises.
- #6017 studies zero-preserving polynomial arithmetic words by degree-one extraction. This contribution permits nondifferentiable role bijections but requires fixed coordinatewise conjugacies and exact ADD compatibility. The mathematical objects and price comparisons differ.
- #5944 bounds nonlinear finite-alphabet circuits in a fixed six-frame alphabet. This contribution concerns arbitrary complex scalar bijections under a different connected ADD/native contract and computes no competing finite-alphabet minimum.
